svg.title: $535,000 Operator Revenue to $214,000 Owner Profit
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-base-owner-profit-waterfall; chart type: waterfall; title: $535,000 Operator Revenue to $214,000 Owner Profit; subtitle: Six bars reconcile the Base scenario to a 40.0% net margin; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Formula v2.0 Base totals are canonical; the four expense allocations are illustrative. The first bar is the opening total, middle bars are signed deductions, and the final bar is the ending total rather than another additive movement. Operator revenue already excludes acquisition principal, tenant gross billings, and IOS property costs used to compute retained lease spreads.; caption: $535,000 − $90,000 − $75,000 − $60,000 − $96,000 = $214,000; $214,000 / $535,000 = 40.0%. The $96,000 recurring-overhead allocation equals $8,000 monthly; other deductions are variable transaction expenses.; stages: label: Gross operator revenue; value: $535,000 opening total; numeric value: 535000.0; detail: Combine $260,000 telecom buyout spreads, $95,000 billboard assignment fees, and $180,000 retained IOS spreads. These are operator-level economics, not the underlying property or easement transaction values.; label: Origination and closing support; value: −$90,000 variable expense; numeric value: -90000.0; detail: Allocate transaction-specific sourcing and closing support only after verifying the permitted compensation structure. Do not duplicate contractor costs assigned to recurring overhead.; label: Title, legal, and consent execution; value: −$75,000 variable expense; numeric value: -75000.0; detail: Budget title work, instrument drafting, lender negotiations, recording coordination, and failed-deal legal costs outside the already calculated acquisition spread.; label: Site and permit diligence; value: −$60,000 variable expense; numeric value: -60000.0; detail: Allocate surveys, Phase I reports, zoning verification, engineering checks, and permit diligence. Include abandoned opportunity costs rather than charging only completed deals.; label: Recurring operating overhead; value: −$96,000 annual overhead; numeric value: -96000.0; detail: Reserve $8,000 monthly for contracted administration, software, insurance, accounting, travel, and routine operating support, with no duplication of variable expenses.; label: Annual owner net profit; value: $214,000 ending total; numeric value: 214000.0; detail: The canonical Base result is owner profit after $321,000 modeled operating expenses. Personal taxes, owner distributions, and financing principal movements are not additional operating-expense bars.

rect.title: label: Gross operator revenue; value: $535,000 opening total; numeric value: 535000.0; detail: Combine $260,000 telecom buyout spreads, $95,000 billboard assignment fees, and $180,000 retained IOS spreads. These are operator-level economics, not the underlying property or easement transaction values.

label: Origination and closing support; value: −$90,000 variable expense; numeric value: -90000.0; detail: Allocate transaction-specific sourcing and closing support only after verifying the permitted compensation structure. Do not duplicate contractor costs assigned to recurring overhead.

label: Title, legal, and consent execution; value: −$75,000 variable expense; numeric value: -75000.0; detail: Budget title work, instrument drafting, lender negotiations, recording coordination, and failed-deal legal costs outside the already calculated acquisition spread.

label: Site and permit diligence; value: −$60,000 variable expense; numeric value: -60000.0; detail: Allocate surveys, Phase I reports, zoning verification, engineering checks, and permit diligence. Include abandoned opportunity costs rather than charging only completed deals.

label: Recurring operating overhead; value: −$96,000 annual overhead; numeric value: -96000.0; detail: Reserve $8,000 monthly for contracted administration, software, insurance, accounting, travel, and routine operating support, with no duplication of variable expenses.

label: Annual owner net profit; value: $214,000 ending total; numeric value: 214000.0; detail: The canonical Base result is owner profit after $321,000 modeled operating expenses. Personal taxes, owner distributions, and financing principal movements are not additional operating-expense bars.
